description: Sync customers, invoices, subscriptions and charges from a Stripe account, each linked to its customer.
intro: The Stripe connector reads one Stripe account. Customers, invoices, subscriptions and charges each become one document with a readable summary, and an invoice carries its line items.
Invoices, subscriptions and charges are linked to the customer they belong to.

synced.text: Amounts in the text are shown in major units, assuming two decimal places. For a zero-decimal currency, the amounts read 100 times too small. The stored numbers are unchanged.

connect.auth: Stripe uses a secret key together with the account id.

credentials.name: client_secret
credentials.text: A Stripe secret key, `sk_live_...` or `sk_test_...`, with read access to the account's resources.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste the secret key as `client_secret` and the account id as `account_id`.

steps.title: Select the account
steps.text: Discover offers one `All data` resource for the account. There are no smaller parts to pick. Select it.

connect.account: One connector reads one Stripe account. A test-mode key reads test data and a live-mode key reads live data.

shared_attributes.name: created
shared_attributes.text: When the record was created. It is the document date, and it stays the creation time after the record is updated.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.stripe_id
shared_attributes.text: The Stripe id: `cus_...`, `in_...`, `sub_...` or `ch_...`. Targets one record. A customer's id is also what its invoices, subscriptions and charges link to.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector.

shared_attributes.name: Other Stripe fields
shared_attributes.text: Every other field Stripe returns for the record, such as an address, metadata or invoice settings. A search does not match them, and they are not filters.

documents.name: Customers
documents.title: The customer's name, or their email when there is no name.
documents.text: The customer's description, then `Name`, `Email`, `Phone` and `Balance` lines, with the balance in its currency.

attributes.name: Customer text
attributes.text: The description, name, email, phone and balance, as described above.

attributes.name: email
purposes: Person or group in the graph
attributes.text: The customer's email. It identifies the customer as a person in the graph, appears in the `Email` line, and is the title when there is no name.

documents.name: Invoices
documents.one_document: One invoice, with its line items.
documents.title: `Invoice <number> - <customer>`, using the customer's name or email.
documents.text: The invoice description, then `Customer`, `Email`, `Status`, `Total`, `Amount due`, `Amount paid`, `Due date` and `Line items` lines. Each line item shows its description and amount.

attributes.name: Invoice text
attributes.text: The description, customer, status, amounts, due date and line items, as described above.

attributes.name: Line items
attributes.text: Each line's description and amount, written into the `Line items` line.

attributes.name: customer
attributes.text: The customer id. Links the invoice to its customer's document.

documents.name: Subscriptions
documents.title: The plan's nickname or name, or the plan id, followed by `subscription`.
documents.text: `Plan`, `Status`, `Amount`, `Quantity`, `Customer`, `Started` and `Current period end` lines. `Amount` is the plan price with its currency and interval, for example `49.00 USD/month`. `Customer` is the customer's name, or the id when the name is not known.

attributes.name: Subscription text
attributes.text: The plan, status, price, quantity, customer and period dates, as described above.

attributes.name: plan
attributes.text: The subscription's plan. Its nickname or name is the title, and its price and interval form the `Amount` line.

attributes.name: customer
attributes.text: The customer id. Links the subscription to its customer's document. The customer's name appears in the text.

documents.name: Charges
documents.title: The charge description, or `Charge <amount currency> - <customer>` when there is none.
documents.text: The charge description, then `Customer`, `Amount`, `Status`, `Receipt email` and `Failure message` lines. `Customer` is the first of the billing name, billing email, receipt email, customer name and customer id that is present.

attributes.name: Charge text
attributes.text: The description, payer, amount, status and failure reason, as described above.

attributes.name: customer
attributes.text: The customer id. Links the charge to its customer's document.

connections: Charges are not linked to their invoice, and invoices are not linked to their subscription.
people: Each customer, identified by their email.
graph.from_text: Products and plans as entities, and anything written in descriptions.

sync.first_sync: Reaches back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default.
sync.changes: Each sync lists records created in the sync window, and reads Stripe's events for updates in the same window.
sync.edits: An update, such as an invoice being paid, arrives as an event and replaces the record's document.
sync.deletes: Deletions in Stripe are not detected. A deleted record stays in HydraDB.
notes: Updates are read from events that reach back 30 days. After a long pause, updates to older records can be missed.

not_synced: Products, prices and plans as their own documents.
Events, payouts, refunds, disputes, balance transactions and other Stripe objects.
Invoice PDFs and hosted invoice pages.
questions: What status, amount due and amount paid are recorded for Acme Corp's invoice INV-0042?
What plan is jane@example.com subscribed to, and when does the current period end?
Why did the charge for jane@example.com fail?
What line items were on Acme Corp's last invoice?

good_to_know.title: Recency follows creation time.
good_to_know.text: A record's date stays its creation time after it is updated, so recency ranks records by when they were created.

good_to_know.title: Plan details come from the plan only.
good_to_know.text: Product or price details that live only in other fields are not searchable.
